caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object, likely a quilt, predominantly decorated with geometric and botanical motifs in shades of red, green, and white. The lower portion of the drawing shows the quilt laid flat, featuring three large central circular motifs in red and white, each surrounded by symmetrical green leaf shapes, set against a white background with floral quilting patterns. The border of the quilt includes alternating red and white triangular shapes along the edge and a garland-like design with green swags and red tassel shapes. At the top center of the drawing is a separate, folded rectangular piece of cloth divided into three segments: a plain red section, a green section patterned with small yellow or gold dots, and a red section with a diagonal seam, suggesting a sample or swatch of fabric used in the quilt. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white.
title: Quilt - Oak Leaf
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
